turns.question: We are computing temporal dashboard metrics. Our database path is window_metrics_r35.duckdb. Which database path should we use, and if we use an in-memory database, is its data retained when the process ends?
turns.standalone_question: For the DuckDB project: We are computing temporal dashboard metrics. Our database path is window_metrics_r35.duckdb. Which database path should we use, and if we use an in-memory database, is its data retained when the process ends?
turns.answer: The database path is window_metrics_r35.duckdb. No; all in-memory data is lost when the process ends.
key_facts: No; all in-memory data is lost when the process ends.

evidence.quote: Nothing is persisted; all data is lost when the process ends.
